mapper.select: SELECT FROM vocabulary_theme WHERE status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (owner_type = 'system' OR user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY owner_type ASC, name ASC, id ASC

SELECT revision.id, revision.revision_uid, revision.theme_uid, revision.version, revision.name_snapshot, revision.purpose, revision.prompt_strategy_key, revision.content_format_version, revision.created_at FROM vocabulary_theme_revision revision INNER JOIN vocabulary_theme theme ON theme.theme_uid = revision.theme_uid WHERE revision.theme_uid = #{themeUid} AND revision.version = theme.current_version LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE vocabulary_theme SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND theme_uid = #{themeUid} AND owner_type = 'user' AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE vocabulary_theme SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND theme_uid = #{themeUid} AND owner_type = 'user' AND deleted_at IS NULL
